import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history:
# JOIN : [["Source1_98_0", "Source1_98_1"], ["right_index", "0"]]
# Join df_source0 and df_source1 on df_source0's 'right_index' and df_source1's index (which is 0 after reading)
# Since df_source1 has only one column '0' and no index column specified, its index is default 0..N-1
# So join on df_source0['right_index'] == df_source1.index

# Set df_source1 index to default integer index (already is), so join on df_source0.right_index == df_source1.index
# We do a left join of df_source0 with df_source1 on df_source0.right_index == df_source1.index
# But operation says JOIN with keys ["right_index", "0"], which means join on df_source0.right_index and df_source1 index (0)
# The join type is not explicitly stated, but since the operation_history says JOIN only, default to inner join

# Perform join:
# We can set df_source1 index to default (already is), then join df_source0 with df_source1 on df_source0.right_index == df_source1.index
# Use pd.merge with left_on='right_index', right_index=True

df_joined = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, how='inner', left_on='right_index', right_index=True)

# The joined dataframe columns are: ['right_index', '0_x', '0_y']
# Target schema is ['0_x': float, '0_y': float]
# We need to keep only '0_x' and '0_y' columns, where '0_x' is from df_source0['0'], '0_y' is from df_source1['0']

df_result = df_joined[['0_x', '0_y']].copy()

# Ensure columns are float type as per target schema
df_result['0_x'] = df_result['0_x'].astype(float)
df_result['0_y'] = df_result['0_y'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_98/target_multisource.csv"
df_result.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
